'''Metamorphosis''' is the 35th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on May 4, 2018. The set consists of 65 cards. This set consists mostly of Backwards Compatible [[Star Trek CCG 2nd Edition]] cards converted to [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]] cards.

==Type Breakdown==
*2 [[:Category:Dilemma (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Dilemma]]
*9 [[:Category:Event (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Event]]
*5 [[:Category:Incident (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Incident]]
*2 [[:Category:Interrupt (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Interrupt]]
*4 [[:Category:Mission (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Mission]]
*40 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (1 Borg, 1 Cardassian, 1 Dominion, 25 Federation, 3 Ferengi, 2 Kazon, 3 Klingon, 4 Non-Aligned, and 4 Romulan)
*2 [[:Category:Ship (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Ship]] (1 Bajoran, and 1 Federation)
*1 [[:Category:Time Location (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Time Location]]

'''NOTE:''' There are 4 Dual Affiliations cards, thus the totals are higher than the amount of a card type.

==Rarity Breakdown==
*65 [[:Category:Virtual (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Virtual]]
